script_text: This week, the stars slam the brakes on your biggest ambition. Early this week, Mars, your ruling fire element, squares Saturn in your tenth house of career, and by Wednesday that pressure feels crushing. Aries, your fire element burns through fear. Tuesday is your worst day because the square attacks your public reputation, while Monday brings anxious overwork. Then midweek, Jupiter sextiles Mars, and the tension finally shifts. Late week, Venus enters your fifth house of romance and creativity, sextile your ruling Mars, so love gets playful, magnetic, and deeply intimate. Thursday through Sunday, career clarity returns through steady action, but money blocks may test your courage in the second house. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your fifth house, while Tuesday is your worst day because the square hits hard. Your weekly advice: release one fear-based control, Mars. So follow for your daily cosmic updates.
